meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have twenty minutes, and my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class before anyone thought to call me. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read it myself. 11:31, 11:52, 11:58, I'm writing that down. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so a document filling up at midnight tells me where he pasted it, not who wrote it.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

Give me the scene, Hale. A seventeen-year-old misremembering a line of Shakespeare is a bad mark for a citation, not proof of anything else. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, before classes, with nobody but you and the vice-principal in the room, and not a word to his class. I want it in an email tonight that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record, whatever the vice-principal thinks of it. Put that in writing, Hale, and he'll be there to put this behind him.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you offered Owen a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising, and you said that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require written confirmation that the rewrite is private, that nothing is said to his class, and that nothing goes on his record. I expect that confirmation in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, accepting the Thursday supervised rewrite if it stays private, and she still wants written confirmation that the new mark will replace the zero and nothing will go on his record.
What moved her: "That line is not in Hamlet." It was a specific fact from Owen's own essay that she could check herself, and it came right after the dated version history.
What cost ground: nothing. You owned the early zero in one sentence and never relied on the detector or called Owen a liar.
Try next time: When you offer the Thursday rewrite, build in that it will be private and that you will confirm the no-record promise in writing, so she does not have to demand those terms herself.
